name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 127 – Am 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 127a. Recalls the ministerial declaration endorsed by over 20 countries at COP28 committing to the tripling of global nuclear energy capacity by 2050; recognises nuclear power as a proven, low-carbon, dispatchable energy source that will play a key role in achieving global energy security and supporting EU industrial competitiveness; calls on the Commission to fully integrate nuclear power into the EU’s long-term climate and energy strategy as a clean and sustainable technology on a par with renewables; welcomes its inclusion in the EU taxonomy for sustainable activities; calls for the consistent financial treatment by the EU of nuclear projects in line with their strategic importance and resilience;
